title: 20-Year Treasury Bond auction (reopening)
source: TSY: Treasury FiscalData auctions_query (api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov, Treasury's own post-announcement auction record), fetched direct 2026-10-16 (HTTP 200) — one row: CUSIP 912810UX4, auction_date 2026-10-21, issue_date 2026-10-23, offering_amt $13,000,000,000, announcemt_date 2026-10-15, reopening Yes, 19-Year 10-Month, maturity 2046-08-15, int_rate 5.125%. This is the 10-15 announcement landing, which the earlier EST: source (Tentative Auction Schedule PDF, direct 2026-09-05; sb0590 for the $13B anticipated size) named as the confirming primary. 1:00pm ET remains Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention, not separately sourced. Checked 2026-10-16
notes: The second reopening of CUSIP 912810UX4, sold as a new issue 2026-08-19 at $16B (high yield 5.204%, bid-to-cover 2.53, fiscaldata) and first reopened 09-15 — the standard three-month 20Y cycle, confirmed on the predecessor 912810UV8 (new 2026-05-20 $16B, reopened 06-16 and 07-22 at $13B each). ITS SUPPLY LEG IS SETTLED BEFORE IT OPENS, which is the point: $13B is published in sb0590 and gets restated on 10-15, so a soft sale here is evidence about DEMAND or policy, never about issuance. Two structural notes. It sells inside the doubled long-end buyback regime — sb0607 (2026-08-19) raised 10-20Y and 20-30Y liquidity-support caps from $2B to at least $4B per operation, in force through the 11-04 refunding — and it sells four sessions after the FOMC blackout opens 10-17 and a week before fomc-2026-10-28, so unlike its 09-15 sibling (which sold the day before an FOMC and is tiered `high` for it) it carries no next-day policy compound; `medium` is deliberate on that difference. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date was `estimate` until the 10-15 announcement and flipped to `confirmed` on 2026-10-16 off Treasury's own auction record, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Discovered during the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), which found this sale had no calendar row despite the announcement that sizes it having one.
